fork_fixes: Declare multiple notification-channel readers because the producer-side drop-oldest path also reads from the queue.
Treat bare carriage returns as stderr line terminators and cover CR-only input.
Serialize same-method StreamJsonRpc registration so AddLocalRpcMethod executes exactly once under concurrent handler registration.
Fail closed when manifest entry-point segments disappear during containment validation.
Require strict package.json syntax, validate debug ports, and terminate a timed-out junction helper process.
Bound concurrent inbound request handlers and return ServerBusy when saturated.
Cap inbound Content-Length before StreamJsonRpc buffers a frame and reject invalid request timeout configuration.
Cap queued notification payloads at 8 MiB aggregate and preserve parameterless notifications.
